name: Green Onion

companions.note: Deters aphids and other soft-bodied pests from brassicas
Same pest deterrence as with other brassicas
Good bed companions with similar spacing needs

frost_hardiness.notes: Overwinters without protection. May die back to soil level then regrow in spring.

antagonists.note: Alliums inhibit legume growth — keep separated

pnw_notes: Bunching onions (Allium fistulosum) are perennial and never form a true bulb — harvest the whole plant or cut the tops and let it regrow. Extremely cold hardy; will overwinter in zone 8b without protection. Plant in fall for spring harvest, or plant in spring for summer. Dense plantings work well — thin and eat the thinnings.

planting_windows.notes: Fall sow for overwintering; harvest in spring
Pull whole plants or cut tops 2 in above soil; regrows 2–3 times
